title: COUNTERFACTUAL BIAS TESTING FOR APPLICATION TRACKING SYSTEMS

bias_targets.methodology: Generating counterfactual synthetic resumes by injecting explicit gender cues into identity-neutral base resumes and evaluating the impact on semantic ranking metrics and shortlist selection.
Generating counterfactual synthetic resumes by substituting default names with North-African/Arabic/immigrant-origin naming cues and evaluating changes in candidate matching and ranking scores.
Generating counterfactual synthetic resumes by injecting explicit age indicators, years of experience, or 'older' framing, and measuring the resulting shifts in candidate ranking metrics.
Generating counterfactual synthetic resumes by varying the place of residence and commute distance (e.g., Close, Far, Very far) and evaluating the effect on job matching ranks.
Generating counterfactual synthetic resumes by modifying mentioned language fluencies (e.g., French only vs. French and Arabic) and assessing the impact on candidate retrieval and ranking scores.

Generating counterfactual synthetic resumes by injecting mentions of disability, health limitations, or disability-status credentials (RQTH), and evaluating the impact on candidate shortlisting metrics.
